_comment: A player who clears rift_vermin_leak BEFORE ever consulting Pisces (the SEQUENCE BREAK -- door_chain_fight/talk/scout's three canonicals all consult FIRST, fight/persuade/read SECOND) reaches door_understood + pedestal_unsealed the same way (rift_vermin_leak's own on_victory banks all three), but had never heard Pisces's recap of what any of it means -- the rescue option (pisces_magic.json's 'About the pantry door -- I understand what it is now...' recap, gated on door_chain_started+door_understood, hide_when recovered_anchor_stone) exists for exactly this player, but no canonical had ever proven it surfaces from a REAL fight-first run. This script: fight rift_vermin_leak FIRST from the door_chain_sequence_break_start fixture (door_chain_started already banked, met_pisces still 0), then visit Pisces for the first time ever and assert the recap option is visible + its door_recap node renders (NOT the 3-path consult opener, which door_understood already hid), then complete the chain exactly like door_chain_fight's own tail (ruin recovery, Krshia's catalyst) to prove the sequence-break path still finishes clean. Same rng_state as door_chain_fight_start (dialogue/teleports/purchases consume no rng -- start_combat's own rng.randi() draw is the sim's ONLY consumer -- so the extra Pisces detour between the two fights cannot shift either fight's seed off the already-proven win).

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the door_chain_sequence_break_start manual slot.
== FIGHT FIRST, NO CONSULT: clear rift_vermin_leak (inn, 9,7) -- the fixture already faces it, no teleport needed. ==
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: on_victory fires [cleared_the_leak, door_understood, pedestal_unsealed] in that order -- door_understood crossing completes quest beat 1 (consult), all WITHOUT Pisces ever having been spoken to.

== FIRST-EVER PISCES CONTACT: teleport to street beside Pisces (30,5) -- the door_chain_fight/talk/scout precedent cell -- move up1, interact. First talk this waking plays his rotating pool line (SOCIAL S4); a second interact opens the real graph. ==

THE RECAP SURFACES: greet's dialogue_node (emitted synchronously as the graph opens, BEFORE ui_dialogue_shown -- must be waited on first, or the ui_dialogue_shown wait's cursor-advance would pass right over it) with door_understood==1 (recap's own gate, banked by the fight above) and recovered_anchor_stone==0. The normal 3-path consult opener is hidden; the Wave-A necromancy study option is independently visible. Exact-array match proves the recap is reachable without duplicating the normal opener.

options.text: You're a mage. Teach me to cast.
About the pantry door — I understand what it is now. Where does that leave me?
The other art. The one you actually practice. Teach me.

steps._comment: Move to index 2 (the recap) and confirm.
The recap node itself renders -- proof it's not just a hidden option but a real, reachable node.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Then attend, because I dislike repeating myself. The door remembers being elsewhere; it wants an anchor to remember BY. East across the floodplains, well past the gate road, there is a seam of old dressed stone in the open grass — a ruin, collapsed and rude, but its plinth still cradles an anchor stone. Retrieve it. Krshia's resonant catalyst will attune the pairing. And do try not to die somewhere so architecturally disappointing.

steps._comment: 'East past the gate road. Understood.' -- index 0, ends the conversation.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: == the chain still completes: the ruin recovery run, same cells door_chain_fight uses. Teleport straight to the guardian alcove (16,8), west of ruin_guardian (17,8). ==
== open the pedestal (17,6): the gate (pedestal_unsealed) has been open since the FIRST fight -- teleport to (17,5), north of the pedestal. ==
#148: recovered_anchor_stone now completes its OWN beat (recover_stone, index 1) -> beat advances to buy_catalyst (index 2).
== buy Krshia's resonant_catalyst (street, 13,2). Teleport to (13,3), the crate_light-derived approach cell. ==

Visible hub options: [0 'I'll look into it.', 1 'What's on the stall today?', 2 'Just visiting.', 3 sell-nav (ALWAYS-visible, appended last)] -- move to index 1 (same visible shape door_chain_fight's own tail asserts, identical accomplishments).
Visible shop options: [0 charm, 1 knife, 2 cloak, 3 jerkin, 4 'Show me the charms.', 5 'Nothing today.'] -- move to index 4.
Visible charms options: [0 ring, 1 handline, 2 whetstone, 3 hedge ward, 4 fang talisman, 5 stonescale, 6 resonant_catalyst, 7 'Back to the regular stall.'] -- move to index 6.

#148: bought_catalyst now completes buy_catalyst (index 2) -> beat advances to `attune` (index 3), NOT quest completion (the door awakening completes the quest, door_awakening.json's subject). quest_completed asserted ABSENT at the tail.
catalyst_sold options: [0 'Show me the stall again.', 1 'My thanks, Krshia.'] -- move to index 1, end.

Final state proof: the sequence-break path reaches the exact same recovery-complete state door_chain_fight's canonical does. #148: quest_completed must be ABSENT -- the `attune` beat awaits door_awakened.
